text:
Alex: hey all — first-day question. i'm trying to run a local debug that impersonates a serviceaccount (`kubectl --as=system:serviceaccount:redwood:ci-bot get pods`) but get `Error from server (Forbidden): users "alex" cannot impersonate user "system:serviceaccount:redwood:ci-bot"`. my kubeconfig user is OIDC (oidc:alex).
Priya: welcome! short answer: your user needs impersonation rights. run `kubectl auth can-i impersonate user --as system:serviceaccount:redwood:ci-bot` to verify.
Alex: ran that and it says `no`. i'm guessing missing ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding?
Raj: yep. we don't grant impersonate by default. for personal dev you can request a temporary binding via the access bot. file the form in https://redwood.internal/onboarding/kubernetes -> "Ephemeral Prod Access" (link). for staging/dev namespaces we usually create a RoleBinding that allows `impersonate` on serviceaccounts in that ns.
Alex: is there an approved command to request it? don't want to hand-edit RBAC tickets.
Priya: use the access form or ping @eng-sre with ticket id. the form triggers a short-lived `impersonate` grant (1h) if justification is valid. do not create permanent ClusterRoleBindings for impersonation — security policy is strict on that.
Raj: if you need to test locally without requesting prod-level impersonation, we sometimes create a personal serviceaccount in your `alex-dev` ns and give it edit. then you can `kubectl --as=system:serviceaccount:redwood:alex-dev` locally. Command: `kubectl create sa alex-dev -n alex-dev && kubectl create rolebinding alex-dev-edit --clusterrole=edit --serviceaccount=redwood:alex-dev -n alex-dev`.
Alex: ok makes sense. one more: if i get the temporary grant via the form, how do i inject the creds into my kubeconfig safely?
Priya: the access system returns a short-lived token you can add with `kubectl config set-credentials temp-impersonate --token=<token>` and `kubectl config set-context temp-ctx --user=temp-impersonate --cluster=<cluster> --namespace=...` then `kubectl config use-context temp-ctx`. delete the creds after: `kubectl config unset users.temp-impersonate` and `kubectl config delete-context temp-ctx`.
Alex: perfect. i'll file the form now. thanks!
devex-bot: access-request `AR-4821` created for user alex (impersonate: system:serviceaccount:redwood:ci-bot) — pending approval from eng-sre :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj: tagging @Priya — happy to approve dev/staging requests. for prod @eng-sre will triage.
Priya: welcome aboard again 60a ping here if the form is stuck and we can expedite.
Alex: appreciate it, will report back once i have the token.
